reviewer: Codex, local engineering review; not a third-party legal attestation

hand_authored.basis: Project-authored atoms/bonds and functional-group catalogs; independently rendered locally, with no copied benchmark images.

chembl.basis: Official ChEMBL FAQ identifies the database as Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0 Unported. Existing local ChEMBL 37 train identities are re-rendered; original source IDs are retained.
chembl.obligations: Retain source attribution and notices. Any future adaptation redistribution needs compatible share-alike handling and separate review; this run authorizes no redistribution.

coconut.basis: Official COCONUT documentation labels repository data CC BY 4.0. Live data-service terms say COCONUT places no additional restrictions beyond those of original data owners. These are distinct statements; this review does not assert CC0 or unlimited downstream rights.
coconut.attribution: COCONUT: COlleCtion of Open Natural prodUcTs, Steinbeck Lab and contributing data owners; local coconut_sdf_2d_lite-07-2026 identities and source IDs retained.
coconut.license: CC BY 4.0 in official data documentation; original-owner terms remain applicable
coconut.obligations: Preserve COCONUT and original-source provenance. No new redistribution, ownership claim or blanket statement about every original contributor's rights.

dejavu.basis: Installed DejaVu Sans/Serif font license explicitly permits use/copy; DejaVu changes are public domain and Bitstream Vera notices/conditions remain. Font software is neither modified nor redistributed here.
dejavu.attribution: DejaVu fonts; Bitstream Vera copyright (c) 2003 Bitstream, Inc.; DejaVu contributors

scope_limits: This is a bounded local research-use assessment of already-local data, not legal advice or an external authorization service.
Keep original molecule IDs and full source_provenance in publication evidence; images/SVG/SDF are not chemically relabeled.
Fresh-dev original PNG/SDF are used only for development validation under their existing commitment; no sealed-test access is authorized.
Dataset, model or commercial-service redistribution/deployment is outside this review and requires a separate assessment.
